PLAN "Cardiac Recovery & General Fitness"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary cardiovascular_endurance:
    name "Safe return to fitness post-MI with controlled intensity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Body Endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          arm_circles 10
          shoulder_press 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          chest_stretch 30
          shoulder_stretch 30
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_swings 10
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 2x12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x20 seconds rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          quad_stretch 30
          hip_flexor_stretch 30
      DAY Friday training 35m "Steady Cardio & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 3m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 20m rpe 4
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          forward_fold 30
          spinal_twist 30
    WEEK 2:
